title: CRT diagnostics, rack electronics and service interfaces — controls/displays hardware only

specimens.name: Deep monochrome CRT diagnostic display housing fragment
specimens.description: TOP ROW CELL 1 ONLY. Deep beige/gray industrial CRT bezel/housing fragment with convex dark green-gray glass, pronounced rear depth and ventilation detail; screen off/blank, no controls, labels, graphics or complete workstation. Do not substitute any lamp, beacon or signaling fixture.

specimens.name: Deep color CRT test-monitor housing fragment
specimens.description: TOP ROW CELL 2 ONLY. Deep gray/beige late-1990s color CRT bezel/housing fragment with curved dark glass, thick apparatus-grade case depth and ventilation slots; screen off/blank, no controls, labels or console. Do not substitute any lamp, beacon or signaling fixture.

specimens.name: Rack-mount plug-in electronics module
specimens.description: TOP ROW CELL 3 ONLY. One removable rack electronics module with anodized front plate, two extraction/ejector handles, ventilation slots and captive fasteners; no text, screen, external cable or full rack. Do not substitute any lamp, beacon, horn or signaling fixture.

specimens.name: Replaceable PCB cassette/service module
specimens.description: TOP ROW CELL 4 ONLY. Compact slide-in electronics cassette with beige/gray front face, two extraction tabs and a restrained row of small physical diagnostic LED lenses; all lenses unlit, no labels, exposed PCB artwork or rack. Do not substitute any lamp, beacon or signaling fixture.

specimens.name: Coax diagnostic connector-panel fragment
specimens.description: BOTTOM ROW CELL 1 ONLY. Small anodized panel fragment with exactly four identical coax/BNC-style diagnostic sockets in an even pattern; no cables, text, labels, knobs or surrounding instrument. Do not substitute any horn, siren, lamp, beacon or signaling fixture.

specimens.name: Multipin diagnostic service-interface module
specimens.description: BOTTOM ROW CELL 2 ONLY. Compact service module with one large multipin rectangular connector, one circular multipin connector and two plain mechanical test-access caps; no cables, text, buttons, screen or full panel. Do not substitute any horn, siren, lamp, beacon or signaling fixture.

specimens.name: Removable 3.5-inch diagnostic diskette-drive service insert
specimens.description: BOTTOM ROW CELL 3 ONLY. One compact late-1990s beige-gray instrumentation service-media insert with a single standard 3.5-inch diskette slot, a small unmarked eject mechanism and shallow vent details in a short removable metal module face; no diskette inserted, no text, labels, active indicator lenses, LED bar, screen, complete rack, workstation or computer. This is a physical removable data-logging interface, NOT a warning/status light.

specimens.name: Small specialized monochrome LCD readout module
specimens.description: BOTTOM ROW CELL 4 ONLY. One compact early specialized monochrome LCD hardware module with thick gray bezel and blank/off dark-green display window; no digits, text, buttons, backlight glow or surrounding instrument. Do not substitute any lamp, beacon, windsock or signaling fixture.

sparse status lamps rather than dense grouped diagnostic indication
